Remark The conclusion $\lim_{\beta\to+\infty}\lambda_3({\bf O}_1,{\bf O}_2,{\bf O}_1)=\lambda_1+\delta/2$ of Proposition looks
at first glance similar to the conclusion (54) derived in the proof of Proposition 2.3 $(iii)$ .
However, the arguments used in both proofs are not the same, since the proof of Propo-
sition 4.7 mainly relies on $L^2$ estimates, while that of Proposition 2.3 $(iii)$ is based on $L^1$
estimates, with a reasoning done by contradiction and actually leading to the contradicting
conclusions (53) and (54) . Notice also that the system (26) used in the proof of Propo-
sition is symmetric in $(\tilde{\varphi}_1,\tilde{\varphi}_2)$ , whereas the system (49) derived in the argument by
contradiction in the proof of Proposition 2.3 $(iii)$ is not symmetric in $(\varphi_1,\varphi_2)$ , complicating
its analysis.
